title: October 2026 — In progress
serviceIntro: We support Melissa Jean Art with marketing guidance and practical Shopify improvements that help customers explore the artwork and shop with confidence.
monthlyRecap: Report in progress — this is the start of Melissa Jean Art’s October report. Leanne’s work has focused mainly on marketing consultation, with further website work still planned. We’ll add those updates once completed.

On October 27, we completed two Shopify updates: displaying full artwork images in the Originals and Prints collections, and updating the prints collection so all 29 current prints appear on the first page. Melissa reviewed the changes and confirmed she was happy with the result.

Post-month-end update — November 2, 2026: We updated the search descriptions for 44 products and six collections, giving shoppers and search engines clearer summaries of Melissa’s artwork. The new copy replaces keyword-heavy or repetitive wording, gives individual pieces distinct descriptions and makes the difference between original paintings and prints clearer. Three paintings that previously shared the same description now have their own summaries.

postMonthEndUpdateHtml:
Post-month-end update — November 2, 2026

This work was completed after October ended and is included here as a dated follow-up. The 50 meta-description updates cover 44 products and six collections; they are not 50 confirmed audit errors resolved.

CompletedWorkUpdate
November 2, 2026Product descriptions — 44 productsSaved clearer, artwork-specific descriptions, replacing missing, generic, lengthy or keyword-heavy copy. Included format, size and location details where supported by the existing artwork content.
November 2, 2026Collection descriptions — six collectionsUpdated summaries for featured art, canvas prints, art cards, original paintings, featured products and Lake of the Woods art.
November 2, 2026Originals and printsMade the distinction between original paintings and canvas reproductions clearer within the same 50-page update.
November 2, 2026Distinct artwork summariesGave Reflecting at Leisure, Red Boat at Leisure and Red Boat at Duke’s separate descriptions instead of their previously identical copy. These are included in the 44 products above.
November 2, 2026Saved values checkedConfirmed all 50 final Shopify saves returned the intended descriptions and original SEO title values without errors. Existing titles, including unset values, were restored and retained.

The changes are saved in Shopify. This confirms the saved values, not a fresh storefront crawl. No improvement in rankings, traffic or click-through rate has been measured, and the remaining audit work is still pending.
